title: [Master] - Slice 629913: [Expense Agent][VENDOR] Enforced background itemization required for approvals
summary: Expense Agent now requires itemization when an enabled Expense Policy with policy text applies to the expense category, regardless of the Expense Detail Required setting. Policy-enforced itemizations can skip subcategories, and the non-refundable amount becomes editable for such itemizations.
key_points: Policy-enforced itemization is required when an enabled policy with text applies to an expense category, independent of Expense Detail Required
Policy-enforced itemizations allow blank subcategories, while regular itemizations require them
Policy-enforced itemizations are preserved through auto-population and rule validation
Non-refundable amounts can be edited for policy-enforced itemizations but remain read-only for ordinary itemizations
Comprehensive test coverage added for all Expense Detail Required values and policy scenarios
